queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids, SUM(CASE WHEN order_id='order_id' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS header_rows_visible FROM orders_raw

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT year||'-'||month||'-'||day) AS raw_partitions, MIN(year||'-'||month||'-'||day) AS min_part, MAX(year||'-'||month||'-'||day) AS max_part, COUNT(DISTINCT date_format(date_parse(order_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),'%Y-%m-%d')) AS distinct_order_dates FROM orders_raw
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, MIN(order_date) AS earliest, MAX(order_date) AS latest FROM orders_raw GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 3
SELECT substr(latest,1,7) AS latest_month, COUNT(*) AS order_ids FROM (SELECT order_id, MAX(order_date) AS latest FROM orders_raw GROUP BY order_id) GROUP BY substr(latest,1,7) ORDER BY 1
